title: Filing: X and SpaceXAI move to dismiss their federal antitrust lawsuit in Texas against Apple, resolving accusations of Apple monopolizing smartphone markets (Mike Scarcella/Reuters)
summary: Mike Scarcella / Reuters: Filing: X and SpaceXAI move to dismiss their federal antitrust lawsuit in Texas against Apple, resolving accusations of Apple monopolizing smartphone markets — Elon Musk's X Corp and SpaceXAI said on Monday they have resolved their lawsuit in federal court in Texas …
